            <action
                android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
            <data android:scheme="market" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action
                android:name="android.intent.action.INSERT" />
            <data
                android:mimeType="vnd.android.cursor.dir/event" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action
                android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
            <data android:scheme="sms" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action
                android:name="android.intent.action.DIAL" />

            android:name="com.pubmatic.openwrapapp" />

            <action
                android:name="com.android.vending.billing.InAppBillingService.BIND" />

            android:name="com.google.android.gms" />
        <package
            android:name="com.android.vending" />
        <intent>
            <action
                android:name="com.attribution.REFERRAL_PROVIDER" />
        </intent>
        <package
            android:name="com.facebook.katana" />
        <intent>
            <action
                android:name="android.intent.action.SEND" />
            <data android:mimeType="*/*" />
        </intent>

            <action
                android:name="android.intent.action.SEND_MULTIPLE" />
